summary.en-US: Paint Tree Style Tab branches with 20 bold colors and emoji markers. Markers survive restarts.

description.en-US:
Tree Tab Picasso paints your Tree Style Tab sidebar.

Right-click any tab and choose Tree Tab Picasso:

• Colors — pick one of 20 colors. The tab and all of its descendants get that color.
• Add Emoji… — put an emoji marker on one tab. Search, browse by category, or use recent emoji. Fully keyboard accessible.
• Clear Emoji / Clear Color / Clear Both — remove markers from a tab.
• Clear everything — remove all markers from all tabs.

Markers are saved with each tab, so they come back after a browser restart with session restore, and they go away when the tab is closed.

Requires Tree Style Tab (https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/tree-style-tab/). Firefox does not allow coloring tabs in the normal horizontal tab strip, so colors show in the Tree Style Tab sidebar.

Privacy: this add-on collects no data and makes no network requests.

Support and bug reports: https://github.com/shabo/ff-treetab-picasso/issues

developer_comments.en-US: Requires Tree Style Tab. Found a bug? Open an issue: https://github.com/shabo/ff-treetab-picasso/issues
